# Ayoola Damisile — Software engineer and classical pianist

> Official personal site and canonical entity home: https://www.damisile.name.ng/
> Knowledge Graph: Ayoola Damisile (/g/11ynvpcp11) · Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141703795

## Who
Ayoola Damisile (also: Damisile Ayoola, Ayoola Damisile Ayooluwa) is a Nigerian software engineer and classical pianist. Business Information Technology student at the Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA). Lead Developer at LIGHTSUP ENERGY SOLUTIONS. IBM-certified Cybersecurity Architect (Oct 2026, credential 83Z8PYF1AZ8H) with Google AI Professional credentials. Open-source author of fixmcp and @damisile_ayoola/envvault on npm. Classical pianist and organist.
